R0.name: NO_QUERY_KEEP
R0.description: Baseline unperturbed SLAM; retains all observations without queries.

R1.name: GEOMETRY_ONLY
R1.description: Heuristic motion suppression based purely on displacement >= 0.30m without VLM.

R2.name: ALWAYS_QUERY
R2.description: Full visual reasoning; queries 100% of image-eligible candidates.

R3.name: RANDOM_K
R3.description: Budget-matched uniform random sampling without replacement (evaluated across 10 reproducible random seeds).

R4.name: VISUAL_UNCERTAINTY_K
R4.description: Queries candidates with highest visual ambiguity, blur, or low pixel resolution.

R5.name: GEOMETRY_UNCERTAINTY_K
R5.description: Queries candidates with highest geometric/motion displacement uncertainty.

R6.name: ESTIMATOR_STATE_K
R6.description: Queries candidates with highest landmark support and tracking influence.

R7.name: ESTIMATOR_AWARE_PRIORITY_PROXY
R7.description: Proposed selective router; prioritizes candidates combining high landmark influence with motion ambiguity.

R8.name: ORACLE_RETROSPECTIVE
R8.description: Retrospective analytical upper bound using observed downstream ground-truth impact.
